preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i <= 10**12 for x_i in x)
preconditions.description: Each beauty value x_i must be a non-negative integer not larger than 10^12.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges must connect n vertices with n-1 edges, and each edge must connect two distinct vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of beauties of all paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
